item.summary: Sweden's Finansinspektionen (FI) is inviting interested parties to join a reference group for a new guidance project on tokenised money under its Innovation Compass. The project covers questions that can arise when payments are made using distributed ledger technology (DLT), such as tokenised bank deposits, e-money tokens under MiCA and central bank money on DLT. Kaupr reports that the deadline to register interest is 22 November.
